systems.name: 10.1 Dreadnaught Assembly at Camp
systems.notes: Use Tub's forge to combine recovered components. Requires scaffolding first: build a dreadnaught hangar via Bub. Assembly stages visible in world.

systems.name: 10.2 Two‑Player Crew Roles (Pilot & Engineer)
systems.notes: Pilot (movement, colossal drill, primary weapons). Engineer (boiler management, repair, shield modulation). Grub can fill Engineer seat at reduced efficiency.

systems.name: 10.3 Kaiju‑Scale Movement & Terrain Impact
systems.notes: Slow but massive: 7×7 tunnel bore, flatten hills, wade through lava. Camera zooms out. Fuel consumption scales with actions; requires supply caravans from camp.
